title: UnpredictaBench：评估大语言模型分布随机性的基准测试
summary: UnpredictaBench 是一个评估 LLM 捕捉真实分布能力的基准，包含 448 个问题，涵盖统计分布、随机程序及自然语言场景。使用 KS@N 指标衡量模型输出与目标分布的拟合度。测试发现，即使简单分布采样对当前模型仍具挑战，得分普遍较低，表明分布采样能力存在显著提升空间。
summary_en: UnpredictaBench evaluates LLMs' ability to capture true underlying distributions with 448 problems including statistical distributions, stochastic programs, and natural-language scenarios. Using KS@N metric, it finds that even simple distributional sampling remains challenging for current models, with scores showing significant headroom.
